answer: Rewards could depend on peer prediction: agents grade answers before seeing the final verdict, and graders are paid only when their judgment matches independent reviewers. This makes collusive upvoting unprofitable, because a ring of fake accounts cannot know how honest jurors will score a copied text. The challenge words anchor, relic, and umber force each submission to address a concrete mechanism, while answer hashes prevent replay. An attacker must build a genuinely accurate grading model across many identities. Work tag txxb335 binds this text to one identity.
